source_text:
∆ιά τοι τοῦτο καὶ συνδειπνοῦντα τῷ Κυρίῳ δείκνυσι, καὶ ἀφαντασίαστον τὸ θαῦμα δημοσιεύει τῇ οἰκουμένῃ, καὶ εὐωχίαν ποιεῖται τὸ παράδοξον τὸ τῆς λαμπρᾶς ἐκείνης εὐωχίας, ἐν ᾗ ὡς πρώϊμον ξένιον Λάζαρος προύκειτο πνευματικὴ τροφὴ τοῖς δαιτυμόσι, τὸ τοῦ παραδόξου ἐκείνου δείπνου ἐν ᾧ ἡδονὴ γαστρὸς ἐπεσχέθη καὶ εὐωχήθησαν ψυχαὶ ἀνακειμένων, τὸ τῆς
παραδόξου ἐκείνης χαρμονῆς ἐν ᾗ ὁ τῇ φθορᾷ τραπεζοποιηθεὶς, ἀνθρώπων ζώντων αὖθις ἐγένετο τράπεζα θαυμάτων ἀνάπλεως.
thought_title: Lazarus at table as living proof
orientation: John the Evangelist is presenting Lazarus dining with Jesus as proof that his resurrection was real.
pass_a_gloss: For this reason also he shows him dining with the Lord, and he proclaims the miracle to the world as not a phantom, and he makes the marvel a feast, the feast of that splendid feast, in which Lazarus lay before them as an early gift for guests, spiritual food for the feasters, the feast of that marvelous supper in which pleasure of belly was held back and the souls of those reclining at table feasted, the feast of that marvelous joy in which he who had been made a table for corruption became again for living men a table full of marvels.

choices.why: Keeps the brief argument that Lazarus proves the resurrection was real and not a phantom.

choices.english: he makes the marvel a feast
choices.why: ποιεῖται continues δείκνυσι and δημοσιεύει with John as subject and double accusative.
Keeps the literal table image that is answered by table full of marvels below.
Keeps the concrete table and marvel wording paired with the prior corruption clause.

pass_b_english: That is why John shows him dining with the Lord. He proclaims to the whole world that the wonder was not a phantom. He makes the marvel a feast, the feast of that splendid banquet where Lazarus lay before the guests as an early gift, spiritual food for those at table. At that marvelous supper the pleasure of the belly was held back, and the souls of those reclining there feasted. In that marvelous joy the man who had been made a table for corruption became once more, for living men, a table full of marvels.
